Davey Music is delighted to announce that on Sunday December 20th 2026, we will once again be presenting our ‘Celtic Carols by Candlelight’ event, which was a huge success last year, raising over £6,000.00 for the wonderful Mary's Meals charity. You are invited to take some time out of the typically busy final Sunday before Christmas, and join with an ensemble of fantastic musicians and singers, directed by Patrick Davey, as they present a beautiful programme of seasonal music and readings from Ireland and the other Celtic nations. The event will last for around one hour and this year we are supporting both Mary's Meals and St. Vincent de Paul. Admission is free but we will be inviting those attending, both in person and online, to make donations to support the vital work of both charities. The event will last for around 1 hour and the church will be lit by candles. Everyone is welcome to join us for what promises to be a very special, relaxing and worthwhile event. T‘Celtic Carols by Candlelight’ will take place in St. Michael’s Church, Finaghy Road North, Belfast, beginning at 7:00pm, and the event is being presented in association with the West Belfast family of parishes. There will also be congregational carol singing as part of the event, and seasonal refreshments will be served afterwards. With special thanks to Fr. Ciarán Feeney, PPSt. Michael's, for making this event possible. WHO IS MARY IN GODS PLAN OF SALVATION? Save the date!
